scientific_integrity: Elementary exact cone-convolution and spherical boundary-layer arguments determine the asymptotics. A standalone checker validates integral identities and finite-epsilon comparisons, not the infinite limit or historical novelty.
scientific_limitations: Two independent spherical-area-uniform endpoints on round two-dimensional spherical lunes of opening \(0<\alpha\le\pi\); ordinary great-circle separation. Fixed-angle epsilon expansion is not uniform near \(\alpha=\pi\), and moving-angle asymptotics hold for fixed \(\lambda\), uniformly on its compact intervals. Independent mathematical validation and comprehensive historical-priority verification have not been performed.
title: Sharp antipodal-distance tails and the hemisphere crossover for spherical lunes
